players.product: High-capacitance (1uF-100uF) X5R/X6S BME MLCCs (GRM/GCM series) for PDN decoupling

quarterly_data.quarter: Murata press release: Murata Introduces World's First 2.2F/100Vdc (06-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Murata introduced the GCJ21BD72A225KE02 soft-termination chip MLCC for automotive powertrain and safety equipment, which it calls the world's first soft-termination chip MLCC with 2.2uF at 100Vdc in the 0805-inch (2.0x1.25mm) size, a rating previously only possible in the 1206-inch size; Murata cites an approximately 51% reduction in board mounting area versus its previous 2.2uF/100Vdc offering and approximately 2.2x the capacitance of its previous 0805-inch 100Vdc product, -55C to +125C operation, X7T characteristics; aimed at 48V power systems, ADAS and autonomous driving.
quarterly_data.figure: 2.2uF at 100Vdc; 0805-inch; approximately 51% smaller mounting area; approximately 2.2x capacitance
